// REQ: LANG-311 LANG-312 LANG-313
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

@interface Greeter : NSObject
@property (nonatomic, copy) NSString *name;
- (instancetype)initWithName:(NSString *)name;
- (NSString *)greet:(NSInteger)times;
@end

@implementation Greeter
- (instancetype)initWithName:(NSString *)name {
    self = [super init];
    if (self) { _name = [name copy]; }
    return self;
}

- (NSString *)greet:(NSInteger)times {
    BOOL ok = YES && times > 0;
    id value = nil;
    return ok ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@"Hello, %@! %ld\n", self.name, (long)times] : @"none";
}
@end

int main(void) {
    @autoreleasepool {
        Greeter *g = [[Greeter alloc] initWithName:@"world"];
        NSLog(@"%@", [g greet:2]);
    }
    return 0;
}
